title: The case analysis workbook
summary: A guided route from the first reading to a clear, well-supported analysis.
description: This demonstration shows how a study pack could explain a topic through prompts, a worked example and a practical planning worksheet.
audience: Students exploring case-based learning and analytical report structures.
previewAlt: Demonstration worksheet showing an issue, supporting evidence and a question to explore.

title: The literature review planner
summary: Bring your reading together, one source, theme and connection at a time.
description: This demonstration illustrates a research learning pack built around a reading matrix, source comparison and a theme-planning worksheet.
audience: Students learning to organize sources and develop a literature review.
previewAlt: Demonstration reading matrix with columns for source, key idea and connection.

title: The purposeful revision planner
summary: Turn a stack of notes into focused topics, useful questions and a workable plan.
description: This demonstration illustrates a revision resource with a topic map, retrieval prompts and a weekly planning page.
audience: Students developing an independent revision routine.
previewAlt: Demonstration revision planner with a topic, recall prompt and next review field.
